This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="ROTS" /> [[Senator]] [[Veedaaz Awmetth]] was a member of this species.<ref name="SWVE" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[species]] was distinguished primarily by their textured, fleshy [[Color|red]] skin, large craniums, and sharp [[Tooth|teeth]].<ref name="SWVE" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], including Estornii's appearance, to [[19 BBY]].</ref> a member of this species, [[Veedaaz Awmetth]], was among those who attended [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]'s [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]] on Amidala's [[homeworld]], the [[planet]] [[Naboo]].<ref name="SWVE" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species was first appeared intended to appear the [[2005]] film {{Film|III}}, directed by [[George Lucas]], but ultimately did not make the final cut of the film.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Their first official canon appearance was instead in the [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]] [[Star Wars: Card Trader]] app.<ref name="Topps">{{SWCT|set=Topps Choice 2|cardname=Veedaaz Awmetth}}</ref>

In the 2015 non-canon video game ''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]'', Veedaaz Awmetth was identifed as a Sarrish diplomat.<ref name="Disney Infinity 3.0">''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]''</ref> Despite the game being non-[[canon]], story group member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] confirmed on [[wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that the names provided by the game for previously unidentified characters were considered canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/749616406245699584|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2016-07-03|quote=@LelalMekha Yeah, same with Infinity.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo-LegoName-Twitter.png|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: "@pablohidalgo <nowiki>youtube.com/watch?v=JwxAeHPLpPg</nowiki> The Lego game identifies a few BG characters from TFA, but are those names canonical?"}}</ref> However, it is unknown if the designation referred to Awmetth's species.
